findings.claim: E-PQ implemented persistent temperament plus transient mood as an explicit state machine backed by SQLite/WAL, identity snapshots, event-specific weights, event-quality-modulated learning rate, per-event delta caps, repeated-event attenuation and continuous homeostatic pull.
findings.current_implication: Preserve the functional state-transition logic, but express it through ClayCode/UnifiedDB as explicit replayable transitions instead of hidden mutable process-local state.

findings.claim: Independent EPQ singletons in multiple processes could hold stale vectors; without a refresh before each event, a later chat event could overwrite a homeostasis reset persisted by another process.
findings.current_implication: A future one-module/shared-state FRANK needs authoritative transition identity, no lost-update semantics, snapshot/replay consistency and concurrency tests. Semantic truth cannot live in divergent mutable caches.

findings.claim: The consciousness daemon maintained persistent goal state, attention state, rumination controls, ultradian phases, proprioception, self-vs-environment resource attribution, service-health awareness and a bridge to persistent spatial/body state.
findings.current_implication: Treat goals/body/proprioception as typed state and observable causal inputs; do not copy the historical giant daemon/service topology literally into Clay.

findings.claim: SpatialState provided a persistent location/world-state bridge: activities deterministically mapped to locations, transitions were persisted, dynamic locations could be registered, and body/service topology was exposed as contextual state.
findings.current_implication: The reusable invariant is persistent embodied/world context with explicit transitions and provenance, not the literal room metaphors.

findings.claim: SOMA audits exposed a concentrated failure family: TOCTOU on adapter files, thread shutdown leaks, unsafe bare-bool concurrency, stale runtime config, non-atomic JSON writes, duplicate scoring after restart, adapter-key loss during EMA merge, near-zero baseline drift falsely reported safe, off-by-one safety thresholds, error-path model memory leaks and training-order bias.
findings.current_implication: Convert this historical bug family into mandatory adversarial/differential harness cases: CAS/atomic writes, lifecycle cancellation, restart idempotence, schema/key conservation, zero-baseline metrics, resource cleanup and randomized/reproducible training order.

findings.claim: The March 2026 70-turn comparison reported 11 vs 2 deflections and unique-word ratios 0.843 vs 0.929 for bare Llama vs Frank, plus different long-context degradation patterns. However, the systems also differed in system prompt, output-length policy, memory handling and 30+ active subsystems, so the report cannot isolate the causal contribution of the architecture as a whole or any component.
findings.current_implication: Reuse the prompt battery and longitudinal metrics only after factorizing prompt, context compression, state injection, GWT/re-entry and other mechanisms into controlled ablations with matched generation constraints.

findings.claim: A historically material benchmark file existed at commit 49dfa7f but was absent at the frozen current head, demonstrating that head-only source manifests erase material project history.
findings.current_implication: Project-Frankenstein Level-0 coverage must include commit-history-reachable deleted/superseded artifacts and claim-level chronology, not merely the current tree.
